It means that Robinhood officially recognizes it and makes it a lot easier to discover / gives more visibility in app for users.

If you're bullish on the chain and believe that Vlad really wants to keep growing it like he's publicly stated, I have a hard time seeing them not list those assets eventually.

Especially as BTC / ETH climb back to all time highs.

Point being, still early.

Be patient and keep stacking.
